description: Renaissance art, Greek mythology, opera, astronomy, medicine, deep time, architecture, literature, stamp design and Welsh geography define a run built around highly recognisable subjects that become much less comfortable under exact questioning.

s09e01.description: Passports, leap years, sci-fi, curling, Donatella Versace, anthologies, Percy Pig and Namibia all appear in a wide-ranging ladder that later turns from Donatella to the much older Donatello.

s09e02.description: A reticulated python, Johnny Cash, architectural cupolas, Bell X-1 and high cirrus clouds all appear before Greek mythology brings in Cerberus. Snakes, supersonic flight and a three-headed dog make a surprisingly coherent quiz menagerie.

s09e03.description: The Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya, Formula 1 blue flags and the chronology of Roman emperors lead to Mozart’s duet Sull’aria and its use in The Shawshank Redemption. Art movements also enter the mix.

s09e04.description: A wooden spoon, split ends, ‘two left feet’, Camelot, Britain’s Got Talent and Dartmoor all appear before Holst’s planetary suite supplies the phrase The Bringer of Peace. Arthurian legend and orchestral astronomy occupy the same broadcast without complaint.

s09e05.description: ABBA Voyage, the circulatory system, Welsh First Minister Mark Drakeford, the old trade of tanning leather and chemical-element symbols all appear before botany and medicine converge on digitalis.

s09e06.description: Space bars, ‘repetition is the mother of learning’, flamenco, escape rooms, forensic ballistics, Tesco, the Minotaur, Banksy’s Bristol connections and Top Gun all appear before deep time reaches the Paleozoic.

s09e07.description: NASA programmes are put in order before a disco ball, Peppa Pig, bon appétit, speed bumps, SMS and Ed Sheeran enter the ladder. Astronomy later contributes Bellatrix, giving the episode one especially bright name.

s09e08.description: Scotch eggs, manual-car clutches, book spines and public-relations departments all precede a piece of Gothic architecture: the gargoyle, specifically the grotesque waterspout variety rather than merely any ugly stone creature.

s09e09.description: Kites, thinking on your feet, the meaning of ‘touchy’, antiques programmes, solar eclipses and calamari all appear before literature and mythology converge on Ulysses.

s09e10.description: Skeleton racing, the border shared by Austria and Romania, The English Patient and Marcel Duchamp’s ‘readymades’ all appear before British visual design gets unusually specific with the Machin series.

s09e11.description: Geological massifs, the shoulder’s rotator cuff and Kathryn Bigelow’s films precede the story of Maurice Wilks sketching the original Land Rover in the sand at Red Wharf Bay. Proust’s madeleine also makes an appearance.
